Sub.: Audio Recordings of Earnings Conference Call with Investor(s)/Analyst(s) 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
This is with reference to our earlier letter dated October 24, 2026 regarding Intimation of Earnings 
Conference Call with Investor(s)/Analyst(s) on October 30, 2026 to discuss Financial Performance 
for Q2/H1 FY 2026-27. In this regard, pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the  
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing 
Regulations”) (as amended from time to time), we wish to inform the Exchanges that the Audio 
Recording 
of 
the 
said 
Con-Call 
is 
made 
available 
on 
the 
Company’s 
website  
i.e. www.motilaloswal.com. 
  
To access the Audio Recording: Click here 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours faithfully,  
 
For Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited 
 
 
 
Kailash Purohit
